newsitem.title: SPAIN: OCP, Gines Navarro rise 15 pct limit.
newsitem.headline: OCP, Gines Navarro rise 15 pct limit.

text.p: Shares in Spanish construction groups OCP Construcciones and Gines Navarro rose the 15 percent opening limit on Thursday after news one OCP share would be exchanged for three of Gines Navarro in their merger.

"All the share moves have to do with the merger," a dealer said. "All the construction groups were merging and it had seemed that these two were being left out and now people giving more value to these shares."
Market sources said the Stock Market Commission CNMV had raised the suspension of the two groups following news of the merger on Monday.
At 0900 GMT, OCT was trading up 1,050 pesetas, or 14.98 percent at 8,060. Gines Navarro was up 365 pesetas, or 14.31 percent, at 2,915.
